items.markdown:
The "best" AI visibility or Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) tracking tool depends heavily on your budget, whether you manage a single brand or multiple clients, and if you are already using traditional SEO software.

Currently, **Semrush**, **Peec AI** , and **Profound** lead the market across different use cases for tracking how often your brand is cited or mentioned across LLMs like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.[](https://zapier.com/blog/best-ai-visibility-tool/) [[1]](https://zapier.com/blog/best-ai-visibility-tool/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DMPSZw75vko)

### Quick Comparison of Top AI Visibility Tools

| Tool | Best For | Key Strengths | Considerations |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Semrush AI Toolkit** | **All-in-one SEO & GEO** | Bridges traditional SEO with AI search monitoring; great competitor benchmarking. | Doesn't cover as many standalone LLM models. |
| **[Peec AI](https://www.frase.io/blog/the-10-best-ai-visibility-tools-in-2026)** | **Agencies & Scale** | Built by SEO veterans; excellent multi-client setups and deep citation gap analytics. | Focused purely on tracking; requires separate tools to execute fixes. |
| **[Profound](https://www.usegrowthos.com/blog/best-ai-visibility-tools)** | **Enterprise Depth** | Highly advanced prompt analytics, compliance tracking, and ROI/traffic modeling. | Higher price point; requires structured onboarding. |
| **Otterly.AI** | **Startups & Solopreneurs** | Very affordable entry-level pricing; straightforward brand mention tracking. | Tight limits on prompt volume at lower tiers. |
| **[Scrunch AI](https://www.position.digital/blog/best-ai-visibility-tracking-tools/)** | **Actionable Insights** | Segment prompts by buyer persona; real-time manual data refreshes. | No free trial available. |

### 1. Semrush AI Toolkit — Best for Integrated SEO teams

If your team is already standardized on **Semrush** , adding their AI tracking is the most logical choice. It calculates an "AI Visibility Score" and monitors your brand across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and Gemini.[](https://kime.ai/blog/best-ai-visibility-tools) [[1]](https://kime.ai/blog/best-ai-visibility-tools)[[2]](https://www.stylefactoryproductions.com/blog/best-seo-ai-visibility-tools)[[3]](https://exposureninja.com/blog/best-ai-search-visibility-tools/)

- **Pros:** Blends keyword research, backlinks, and traditional SEO tracking with AI sentiment mapping.
- **Cons:** Might lack the granular prompt-level depth found in specialized, standalone GEO platforms.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5kNShp1RuMQ&t=26) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5kNShp1RuMQ&t=26)[[2]](https://www.frase.io/blog/the-10-best-ai-visibility-tools-in-2026)

### 2. Peec AI — Best for Marketing Agencies

For agencies managing multiple accounts, **Peec AI** shines with its ability to cluster large batches of text prompts and run daily multi-model checks. It helps you visualize your clients' exact share of voice relative to competitors in natural, conversational contexts.[](https://www.frase.io/blog/the-10-best-ai-visibility-tools-in-2026) [[1]](https://www.frase.io/blog/the-10-best-ai-visibility-tools-in-2026)[[2]](https://www.position.digital/blog/best-ai-visibility-tracking-tools/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DMPSZw75vko)

- **Pros:** Highly intuitive dashboard; includes "pitch project" capabilities to help agencies sell AI optimization services to prospects.
- **Cons:** Premium pricing structure that scales up sharply with high prompt volumes.[](https://www.position.digital/blog/best-ai-visibility-tracking-tools/) [[1]](https://www.position.digital/blog/best-ai-visibility-tracking-tools/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5kNShp1RuMQ&t=26)[[3]](https://www.frase.io/blog/the-10-best-ai-visibility-tools-in-2026)

### 3. Profound — Best for Enterprise Brands

**[Profound](https://wpengine.com/blog/ai-visibility-tracking-tools/)** treats LLM outputs like a dynamic ecosystem rather than a static ranking page. It is engineered for large corporations that need to uncover untapped prompts, look for compliance gaps, and audit brand sentiment across an enterprise scale.[](https://wpengine.com/blog/ai-visibility-tracking-tools/) [[1]](https://wpengine.com/blog/ai-visibility-tracking-tools/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5kNShp1RuMQ&t=26)[[3]](https://www.frase.io/blog/the-10-best-ai-visibility-tools-in-2026)[[4]](https://www.usegrowthos.com/blog/best-ai-visibility-tools)

- **Pros:** Deep content-gap identification and advanced analytics.
- **Cons:** Long sales and setup cycle; less accessible for smaller budgets.[](https://www.usegrowthos.com/blog/best-ai-visibility-tools) [[1]](https://www.usegrowthos.com/blog/best-ai-visibility-tools)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5kNShp1RuMQ&t=26)[[3]](https://www.frase.io/blog/the-10-best-ai-visibility-tools-in-2026)

### 4. Otterly.AI — Best for Tight Budgets

If you are a solo founder or small business just trying to get a baseline on where you stand, **Otterly.AI** offers an incredibly accessible entry point. Starting at a budget-friendly tier, it scans core engines like ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.[](https://www.frase.io/blog/the-10-best-ai-visibility-tools-in-2026) [[1]](https://www.frase.io/blog/the-10-best-ai-visibility-tools-in-2026)[[2]](https://zapier.com/blog/best-ai-visibility-tool/)[[3]](https://www.usegrowthos.com/blog/best-ai-visibility-tools)

- **Pros:** Cheap, clean, and requires almost zero onboarding to get moving.
- **Cons:** Strictly limited to a small number of daily trackable prompts unless you upgrade.[](https://www.frase.io/blog/the-10-best-ai-visibility-tools-in-2026) [[1]](https://www.frase.io/blog/the-10-best-ai-visibility-tools-in-2026)[[2]](https://www.position.digital/blog/best-ai-visibility-tracking-tools/)[[3]](https://zapier.com/blog/best-ai-visibility-tool/)

To narrow down the best tool for your workflow, could you share:

- Are you looking for a **standalone platform** or an extension of an **existing SEO tool** (like Semrush or Ahrefs)?
- What is your **estimated budget** or **team size** ? (e.g., Solopreneur, Agency, Enterprise)
- Approximately **how many keywords or prompts** do you need to track daily?[](https://www.stylefactoryproductions.com/blog/best-seo-ai-visibility-tools) [[1]](https://www.stylefactoryproductions.com/blog/best-seo-ai-visibility-tools)[[2]](https://www.frase.io/blog/the-10-best-ai-visibility-tools-in-2026)[[3]](https://www.usegrowthos.com/blog/best-ai-visibility-tools)[[4]](https://zapier.com/blog/best-ai-visibility-tool/)
